dispositionSemantics.MAIN: Default branch; not subject to branch cleanup.
dispositionSemantics.OPEN_PR_KEEP: Preserve while an associated PR remains open.
dispositionSemantics.MERGED_EXACT_TIP_ARCHIVE_CANDIDATE: The current branch head SHA exactly matches a merged PR head SHA. This is only an archive/delete candidate after checking release, deployment, evidence and ownership references.
dispositionSemantics.MERGED_PR_BUT_BRANCH_TIP_MOVED_REVIEW: A related PR merged but the current branch has moved since that PR; do not delete based on the PR alone.
dispositionSemantics.CLOSED_UNMERGED_REVIEW: Associated PR closed without merge; preserve pending explicit review.
dispositionSemantics.NO_PR_ASSOCIATION_REVIEW_REQUIRED: No matching PR head branch name found in the retrieved complete PR list; this is not proof of uselessness or unmerged commits.

note: This is a complete point-in-time inventory and evidence-based triage, not an instruction to delete branches. Exact merged PR head matching does not prove absence of deployment aliases, release assets, evidence files or external references. No branch is deleted by this report.
